sent.subject: Q3 delivery delays
sent.body:
Hi Amy,

Following up on our call this morning: I'm sorry for the trouble with the late Q3 shipments. Could you send me the PO numbers and the delays your sites saw, so I can close it out with our logistics team? As discussed, we'll put a credit on your account.

Best,
Maya

sent.subject: Re: Q3 delivery delays
sent.body:
Hi Amy,

Thanks for confirming the details. The credit will be applied on the November invoice, and our logistics team has moved your lanes back to the previous carrier. Let's go through the root cause together at the quarterly review on the 26th.

Best,
Maya

sent.subject: Re: Aurora warehouse project: early specs
sent.body:
Hi Amy,

Thanks for the early specs. We'd very much like to bid on Aurora. I'll bring Kevin, our sales engineer, to the quarterly review so we can talk through scope and timing, and we'll put it on the agenda.

Best,
Maya

sent.subject: Re: Co-marketing plan draft

Maya
